#     series): relaton/relaton-data-iala data/*.yaml, primary IALA
#     docidentifiers (863 records total).
#   - The codeless slug publications: relaton-data-iala's 162 records
#     that relaton#604 reported as unindexable (hand-off
#     iala-codeless-publications); the docid is the product-URL slug.
#   - The cover MRN URNs: transcribed from the PDFs in
#     metanorma/mn-samples-iala reference-docs, per the IALA Style
#     Guide (G1115, Ed 1.0 January 2021) document-reference clause.
#     The two r1026 variants are printed malformed in the published
#     PDF (capital marker Ed1.0; separator dot ed.1.0) and are kept
#     byte-identical: the parser normalizes both to ed1.0.
#   - The S-100-family product specifications (gem#777): iala.int,
#     "IALA S-200 Product Specification and Development Status" — IHO
#     granted IALA the numbering series S-201 to S-299, compliant with
#     the IHO S-100 standard; the dev-status pages name S-201, S-210,
